text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you dummy! Apologizing  won't fix
anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Take this experience as a lesson so you
can do
better next time for your king.
Understand?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. But don't you worry. A tiny
failure like this
won't get me down. A
first-rate Umamusume
knows how to
rebound!
